mil3.4.9:0.3: 9. The Question on Who Gains Extinguishment
mil3.4.9:1.2: “Sir Nagasena, do all of them attain extinguishment”?
mil3.4.9:1.3: “No, Great King, not all of them attain extinguishment. But, Great King, whoever has entered rightly, directly knowing things that should be known, completely understanding things that should be understood, abandoning things that should be abandoned, developing things that should be developed, realizing things that should be realized, that person attains extinguishment”.
